name: prepare_creator_interactions
description: Save 1-10 creator-authored comment or danmaku drafts for human preview. This NEVER sends anything. Read the matching smart-comment or smart-danmaku skill and analyze the current video first. Use native items objects, not encoded JSON strings. Only the separate authenticated human confirmation endpoint can publish.

video_id.description: Authorized video/room ID from confirmed_conditions or the current validated page; do not substitute a historical video.

video_evidence_id.description: Same-run evidence_id returned by analyze_video_content for this video and the authorized playback scope; not feedback evidence or a report artifact.

kind.description: Draft kind matching the frozen creator.draft task: COMMENT or DANMAKU. Creating a draft does not publish it; sending requires the page confirmation flow.

text.description: Draft message text, not HTML or a tool instruction. COMMENT supports up to 500 characters; DANMAKU supports up to 80. Write for the creator and ground video-specific statements in the supplied video evidence.

playback_ms.description: DANMAKU requires an integer playback position in milliseconds within the analyzed video interval (start inclusive, end exclusive). COMMENT must omit this field. This is not a sending timestamp.

items.description: Native JSON array of 1-10 draft objects, not a JSON string. Each object has text and, for DANMAKU, playback_ms. Only draft previews are created.
